name: Hurricane Lowell
headline: Category 5 on 2 Sep; ridge weakened 5 Sep and an upper low pulled it north (Iniki-like track).

sections.The setup: Warm central Pacific during the record El Niño.
sections.The trigger: Category 5 on 2 Sep; ridge weakened 5 Sep and an upper low pulled it north (Iniki-like track).
sections.What amplified it: Passed about 80 miles from Kauaʻi as Cat 2 (provisional best track: 83 miles at 90 kt, 8 Sep 09 UTC): gusts 92 mph, 21.1 in rain, surge; track shifted 10–15 miles east of forecast.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
